registlet.name: Physical Attack Boost
registlet.detail: ATK +1 per level.

registlet.name: Magic Attack Boost
registlet.detail: MATK +1 per level.

registlet.name: Max HP Boost
registlet.detail: MaxHP +10 per level.

registlet.name: Max MP Boost
registlet.detail: MaxMP +1 per level.

registlet.name: Physical Defense Boost
registlet.detail: DEF +1 per level.

registlet.name: Magic Defense Boost
registlet.detail: MDEF +1 per level.

registlet.name: Accuracy Boost
registlet.detail: Accuracy +1 per level.

registlet.name: Dodge Boost
registlet.detail: Dodge +1 per level.

registlet.name: Attack Speed Boost
registlet.detail: ASPD +1 per level.

registlet.name: Magic Speed Boost
registlet.detail: CSPD +1 per level.

registlet.name: Wayfarer
registlet.detail: Increases EXP Gain by 10% but lowers damage dealt by 15% (-1% per level).

registlet.name: Sunbath
registlet.detail: When using Emotions that increase Natural Regen, an additional 25% of MP per level will be recovered.

registlet.name: Hard Hit Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Hard Hit` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Sonic Blade Extender
registlet.detail: Extends the time you must reuse `Sonic Blade` to turn it into `Super Sonic Blade` by 1 second per level.

registlet.name: Power Shot Boost
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Power Shot` by 15% per level when [Tumble] is inflicted.

registlet.name: Bullseye Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Bullseye` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Magic: Arrow Enhancer
registlet.detail: Adds 1 shot per level to the skill `Magic: Arrows`.

registlet.name: Magic: Wall Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Magic: Wall` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Smash Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Smash` by 5% per level if used with knuckles.

registlet.name: Sonic Wave Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Sonic Wave` by 5% per level if used with knuckles.

registlet.name: Twin Slash Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the critical damage from `Twin Slash` by 1% per level.

registlet.name: Cross Parry Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Cross Parry` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Flash Stab Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Flash Stab` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Cannon Spear Enhancer
registlet.detail: Adds a 10% per level chance of inflicting [Flinch] to the first attack.

registlet.name: Issen Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of the second hit of `Issen` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Pommel Strike Enhancer
registlet.detail: Extends the duration of [Paralysis] caused by the skill `Pommel Strike` by 1 second per level.

registlet.name: Poison Heal
registlet.detail: 1% per level chance of having [Poison] status removed when taking damage inflicted by [Poison].

registlet.name: Cat's Eye
registlet.detail: A MISS hit while afflicted with [Blind] may be turned into a GRAZE hit when possible.
registlet.note: Chance is unknown.

registlet.name: Emergency HP Heal
registlet.detail: Instantly restores 10% (+1% per level) of your HP when there is only 25% HP or less due to monster's attacks. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

registlet.name: Emergency MP Heal
registlet.detail: Immediately restores 10 MP per level if there is not enough MP. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

registlet.name: Neural Control
registlet.detail: Reduces the amount of ASPD lowered due to [Paralysis] by 2% per level.

registlet.name: Final Resistance
registlet.detail:
If you get knocked out last in the party, you will squeeze through every last bit of your strength to quickly revive for 5 seconds (+1 second per level) before becoming unable to battle again.
*First Aid, Struggle, Revive Droplets Unavailable.

registlet.name: Elemental Trigger Slash
registlet.detail: Converts the element of `Trigger Slash` from fire to that of the weapon equipped.

registlet.name: Spiral Air Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Spiral Air` by 2% per level.

registlet.name: Paralysis Shot Extender
registlet.detail: Extends the duration of buff from the skill `Paralysis Shot` by 1 second per level.

registlet.name: Magic: Lances Catalyst
registlet.detail: Shortens the interval between shots of the skill `Magic: Lances` by 0.1 second per level.

registlet.name: Magic: Blast Catalyst
registlet.detail: Shortens the time to cast the skill `Magic: Blast` by 0.2 second per level.

registlet.name: Power Wave Modifier
registlet.detail:
Modifies the effect of `Power Wave` so that it raises normal attack power by 0% instead of extending the range.
*The increment depends on the skill level.
registlet.note: 0.5% increase per skill level (Lv1 is 0.5% but rounded down), 0.5% increase per Registlet level (so max 10% with Lv10 on both).

registlet.name: Earthbind Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Earthbind` by 5% per level if used with knuckles.

registlet.name: Spinning Slash Compress
registlet.detail: Reduces the range of `Spinning Slash` and removes the [Knock Back] effect, but raises its power by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Critical Charging Slash
registlet.detail: Lowers the power of `Charging Slash` by 110% (-10% per level) and guarantees a critical hit.

registlet.name: Dragon Tail Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of the second hit of `Dragon Tail` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Mega War Cry of Struggle
registlet.detail: Increases the aggro generated by the skill `War Cry of Struggle` by 300 per level.

registlet.name: Static Triple Thrust
registlet.detail: You will remain in the same spot when using the skill `Triple Thrust`.

registlet.name: Magadachi Amulet
registlet.detail: Raises magic damage reduction by the skill `Magadachi` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Meikyo Shisui Preserver
registlet.detail: The effect from `Meikyo Shisui` remains when using a skill.

registlet.name: Steady Stance
registlet.detail: Reduces damage taken while afflicted with [Stop] by 3% per level if you stand still.

registlet.name: Shared Destiny
registlet.detail:
Each party member (excluding yourself) will raise your ATK and MATK by 1%, but 110% (-10% per level) of HP will be lost whenever a member gets knocked out.
*This HP loss could knock player out.

registlet.name: Shell Break Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the chance to inflict [Armor Break] with the skill `Shell Break` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Forty Winks
registlet.detail: Shortens [Sleep] duration by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Tanker's Pet
registlet.detail: Lowers the damage received by pet by 3% per level, but greatly increases the damage received by its owner.

registlet.name: Last Hero
registlet.detail: Restores 10% (+1% per level) of your HP and MP per knocked out party member when you are the only one left. Cooldown: 300 seconds.

registlet.name: Monophobia
registlet.detail:
Restores 100 HP per 10 seconds when near a party member, but when not, 100 HP will be lost.
*This HP loss won't knock player out.
registlet.note: Healing range: 3m, range increases by 1m per level.

registlet.name: Pyrexia
registlet.detail: 5% per level chance of having [Freeze] status removed if you do a normal attack while frozen.

registlet.name: Impetus
registlet.detail: Reduces movement speed decline due to [Slow] by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Silent Recharge
registlet.detail: Increases amount of MP recovered by 5% per level if `MP Charge` is used while afflicted with [Silence].

registlet.name: Attacker's Pet
registlet.detail: Raises the damage dealt by pet by 3% per level, but greatly decreases its owner's.

registlet.name: Mana Thrash
registlet.detail: Raises normal attack power in exchange for AMPR.
registlet.note: Power increases more with higher AMPR.

registlet.name: Parsimony
registlet.detail: Instead of consuming a triggered auto-item, the item cooldown is doubled. Cooldown: 40 seconds (-1 second per level).

registlet.name: Emergency Repair
registlet.detail: 5% per level chance of having [Armor Break] status removed when the damage taken increases because of it.

registlet.name: Mana Defuser
registlet.detail: Immediately recovers 100 MP per level if you survive [Mana Explosion].

registlet.name: Coffee Break
registlet.detail: Restores 10% of your HP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: 30 seconds (-1 second per level).

registlet.name: Eagle Eye
registlet.detail: Reduces damage taken from behind (opposite camera direction) by 1% per level. The damage will be further reduced when taken from directly behind.

registlet.name: Savior
registlet.detail: Grants 10-second [Invincible] if you revive when all of your party members get knocked out.

registlet.name: Sword Tempest Extender
registlet.detail: Adds 1 hit to the skill `Sword Tempest`.

registlet.name: Remedial Rampage
registlet.detail: Removes the finishing attack of the skill `Rampage` and restores 50 HP per level.

registlet.name: Smoke Dust Extender
registlet.detail: Extends the duration of buff from the skill `Smoke Dust` by 1 second per level.

registlet.name: Piercing Heavy Smash
registlet.detail: Adds a 5% of Physical Pierce to the skill `Heavy Smash` if used with knuckles.

registlet.name: Phantom Slash Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Phantom Slash` by 5% per level.

registlet.name: Focus Dive Impact
registlet.detail: Turns the skill `Dive Impact` into an attack that pierces through a single target. Resistance to [Dazzled] is shortened by 2 seconds per level.

registlet.name: Pursuit Relief
registlet.detail: Reduces damage taken by 1% per level when you can't move while afflicted with [Flinch], [Tumble] or [Stun].

registlet.name: Burning Spirit
registlet.detail: Restores MP as much as 5% per level of your AMPR when taking damage inflicted by [Ignite].

registlet.name: Bloody Warrior
registlet.detail: Raises normal attack power and AMPR by 5% per level while afflicted with [Bleed].

registlet.name: Monster Hunter
registlet.detail: Restores 100 MP when you defeat a monster. Cooldown: 30 seconds (-1 second per level).

registlet.name: Panic
registlet.detail: Restores 10 MP (+1 MP per level) every 3 seconds, but all MP will be lost if you get aggro and this Registlet will be suspended for 30 seconds.

registlet.name: Transfer
registlet.detail:
Lowers MaxMP by 1100 (-100 per level), but when you are knocked out, the remaining MP will be shared among your party members.
*Players whose MP gets restored by this effect cannot enjoy the same effect for 180 seconds.

registlet.name: Berserk Control
registlet.detail: `Rampage` state has a 10% chance of not getting removed per level of `Berserk` acquired.

registlet.name: Decoy Shot Compress
registlet.detail: Halves the duration of `Decoy Shot` but increases the power by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Frugal Shield Bash
registlet.detail: Restores 10 MP per level when `Shield Bash` inflicts [Stun].

registlet.name: Extra Recovery
registlet.detail: Adds a HP recovery effect to the skill `Recovery`. The amount of HP restored is 10% per regisltet level of the HP recovered by the `Mini Heal` learned.
registlet.note: The caster's `Mini Heal`. The HP recovery effect is applied to both the target and the caster

registlet.name: Frugal Heal
registlet.detail: Reduces the MP Cost of the skill `Heal` by 100.

registlet.name: Extreme Whack
registlet.detail: Increases the activation rate of `Whack` by 1% per level.

registlet.name: Extreme Concentrate
registlet.detail: Increases the activation rate of `Concentrate` by 1% per level.

registlet.name: Secret Chase ATK Boost
registlet.detail: Increases the activation rate of additional attack of `Secret Chase Attack` by 1% per level of the skill acquired.

registlet.name: Power Resonance
registlet.detail: `Resonance` will only enhance stats that affect *firepower, but the enhancement is reduced by 95% (-5% per level).
registlet.note:
*ATK/MATK.
If multiple Resonance Registlets are equipped, the first Resonance Registlet equipped will take effect.

registlet.name: Speed Resonance
registlet.detail: `Resonance` will only enhance stats that affect *acceleration, but the enhancement is reduced by 95% (-5% per level).
registlet.note:
*ASPD/CSPD.
If multiple Resonance Registlets are equipped, the first Resonance Registlet equipped will take effect.

registlet.name: Focus Resonance
registlet.detail: `Resonance` will only enhance stats that affect *concentration and precision, but the enhancement is reduced by 95% (-5% per level).
registlet.note:
*Accuracy and Critical Rate.
If multiple Resonance Registlets are equipped, the first Resonance Registlet equipped will take effect.

registlet.name: Bloody Bite Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Bloody Bite` by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Dominant War Cry
registlet.detail: The activation of `War Cry` will no longer be interrupted by [Fear].

registlet.name: Full Power Qi Charge
registlet.detail: When `Qi Charge` gives no effect, qi will increase by 10% per level if the skill is activated using 2000 MP.

registlet.name: Single Meteor Strike
registlet.detail: Reduces the number of meteorites dropped from `Meteor Strike` to 1, but the drop point will no longer be random. It will no longer inflict status ailments either.

registlet.name: Start Dash
registlet.detail: Normal attack has 0 second cooldown for 5 seconds (+1 second per level) when getting aggro from the target monster for the first time. Cooldown: 60 seconds

registlet.name: Secret Combo
registlet.detail: Reduces aggro by 1% per level per 1 combo. Better effect with longer combo.

registlet.name: Zero Stance
registlet.detail:
Damage dealt with skill activated without using a combo is multiplied by 1.00 (+0.01 per level).
*Does not apply to some skills such as charge skills.

registlet.name: Express Assault Attack
registlet.detail: Removes [Knock Back] and [Slow] from `Assault Attack` and increases its power by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Rage Sword Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the power of `Rage Sword` by 10% per level. Aggro doubles if the target is hostile towards you.

registlet.name: Comrade Familia
registlet.detail: The chance of familiar summoned with `Familia` fleeing is reduced by 1%. Movement becomes 1 second faster for `Advanced Familia`.

registlet.name: Tricky Shadow Walk
registlet.detail: Additional attack of `Shadow Walk` will no longer cause proration.

registlet.name: Mega Royal Heal
registlet.detail: The range of `Royal Heal` effect is increased by 1m per level, but the amount of HP restores is halved.

registlet.name: Short Performance
registlet.detail:
Shortens the duration of dance skill effect by 5 seconds.
*Does not apply to `Spirited Dance`.

registlet.name: Arrow Rain Enhancer
registlet.detail: Increases the number of hits of `Arrow Rain` by 1 per level.

registlet.name: Ether Flare Extender
registlet.detail: Doubles the duration of the `Ether Flare` buff, but halves the buff's AMPR gain.

registlet.name: Mana Crystal Catalyst
registlet.detail: Reduces the casting time of `Mana Crystal` by 10% per level, but the amount of MP recovered gets reduced by 100.

registlet.name: Assassin Stab Enhancer
registlet.detail: Raises the base multiplier of `Assassin Stab` by 1% per level. Furthermore, if the `Assassin Stab` performed is a `Back Stab`, the accuracy of the attack increases by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Holy Light Retribution
registlet.detail: There is a 1% chance that LvX* light element `Magic: Finale` will activate when `Holy Light` hits the target.
registlet.note: *The skill level of the `Magic: Finale` is equal to the Registlet's level.

registlet.name: Focus Demon Claw
registlet.detail: The power of `Demon Claw` is reduced by 100% but the skill will focus on attacking a single target.
registlet.note: The base multiplier of `Demon Claw` is 100 (+10 per skill level). With this Registlet, that base multiplier becomes 10 per skill level.

registlet.name: Silent P. Defense
registlet.detail: Reduces the aggro generated when `P. Defense` is successful by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Binding Strike Modifier
registlet.detail: Modifies `Binding Strike` so that it inflicts [Stun] to the target only and the [Stop] effect is removed.
registlet.note: In this case, the [Stun] chance is 10% per skill level.

registlet.name: Heal Bank
registlet.detail:
The amount of HP recovered by `Mini Heal` and `Heal` is halved.

Accumulates up to 1 stack of buff per level every 3 seconds. When using the skill to heal an ally, the buff is consumed instead of MP to activate it.
registlet.note: The extra MP cost due to `Asura Aura` is still paid even when using the Heal Stacks.

registlet.name: Chancy Trap
registlet.detail: Enables trap skills from the `Hunter` skill tree to be set at the target's feet, but if the trap activates immediately, you will also be affected.
registlet.note:
Self Ailment Duration due to Traps:
`Sleep Trap`: [Sleep] @15 seconds
`Bear Trap`: [Stop] @10 seconds
`Land Mine`: [Ignite] @10 seconds
`Dark Trap`: [Lethargy] @10 seconds

registlet.name: Guitarist
registlet.detail:
Allows smooth song resumption with `Ad-Lib`.
A successful parry with `Ad-Lib` grants 1 stack of `Beat Blast` per level.

registlet.name: Fighter's Magic: Impact
registlet.detail: Changes the proration dealt by `Magic: Impact` to physical proration.

registlet.name: Maximizer Converter
registlet.detail: Switches `Maximizer` to activate `MP Charge` instead when used alone (i.e., not part of a combo) and the condition for instant activation is not met.

registlet.name: Perfect Triple Thrust
registlet.detail: Restores 10 MP per level if `Triple Thrust` is successfully activated without taking any damage when used alone.

registlet.name: Evasive Floating Kick
registlet.detail: Gain [Invincible] for 1 second if `Floating Kick` is activated while moving.

registlet.name: Mega Demon Wind Shuriken
registlet.detail: MP Cost of `Demon Wind Shuriken` increases by 300 (-100 per level) and in exchange, the number of times power goes up increases by 1 time.
registlet.note: It means the number of times the shuriken can hit without reduced damage is increased by 1.

registlet.name: Dragon Fire Release
registlet.detail: The time to cast `Fire Release` is increased by 1 second to get 2.5% per level Magic Pierce. The increase of Magic Pierce doubles when the skill changes.
registlet.note: Doubles if `Blazing Explosion` is triggered.

registlet.name: Protection Aegis
registlet.detail:
When `Protection` is activated, the `Aegis` you've acquired will also be activated at the same time.
*It also works the other way around.

registlet.name: Frugal Breathwork
registlet.detail: Reduces the MP Cost of `Breathwork` by 100.

registlet.name: Fire Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to fire element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Water Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to water element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Wind Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to wind element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Earth Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to earth element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Light Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to light element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Dark Talent
registlet.detail: Sets skill effects that change based on element to dark element.
registlet.note: This does not provide awaken element. It just changes the effect of the skill!

registlet.name: Emergency Care
registlet.detail:
Reduces the MP Aggro triggered by `First Aid` by 1 per level.
*Up to MP cost 100 at the minimum.

registlet.name: Direct Sonic Thrust
registlet.detail: The skill `Sonic Thrust` loses its swift effect but gains an effect that ignores Evasion in return.

registlet.name: Sprint Sheathe Remover
registlet.detail: Sheathing while moving will no longer occur.

registlet.name: Unsheather Wind Release
registlet.detail: Adds 5% Magic Pierce per level to the skill `Wind Release` and when the skill changes, an unsheathe attack attribute is added.

registlet.name: Extreme Chronos Shift
registlet.detail:
`Chronos Shift` can be activated even if there is not enough MP by consuming HP.
60% (-10% per level) HP required per 100 MP that you're short of.
This HP consumption can get you knocked out.

registlet.name: Meteor Magic: Crash
registlet.detail: The size of the meteorites from `Magic: Crash` and their chance to inflict ailments are greatly reduced, but their time to impact is shortened by 0.1 second per level above Lv1, and Guard no longer works against them.

registlet.name: Moonlight Crescent Saber
registlet.detail: While `Crescent Saber` is active, all aggro generated will be reduced by 15% per level. This effect does not activate if you are being targeted.

registlet.name: Target Declaration
registlet.detail: When you are drawing the enemy's attention (aggro), you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat.

registlet.name: Check Out Notice
registlet.detail: When you get knocked out, you will declare it through Party Chat. If it is a Guild RAID, you will declare it through Say Chat.

registlet.name: Instructor
registlet.detail:
Sets your own EXP Gain to 0% to increase the EXP Gain of the party member with the lowest level by 1% per level.
Less effective if there are multiple recipients.

registlet.name: Healing Hands
registlet.detail: Alleviates the reduced recovery of Heal-related Registlets by 10% per level.

registlet.name: Iron Fist
registlet.detail: Guard Break increases by 1% per level when using barehanded or knuckles (main only). The amount increased will be tripled if the sub-weapon slot is empty.

registlet.name: Magic: Storm Extender
registlet.detail: Lowers the power of `Magic: Storm` by 50% to make its effect last 1 second per level longer.
registlet.note: The multiplier is not halved, it is reduced. If the original multiplier is 200%, it becomes 150% with this Registlet.

registlet.name: Parrier Storm Blaze
registlet.detail: A Guard check is added to the skill `Storm Blaze`. A successful Guard with the skill will double the amount of MP recovered.

registlet.name: Sneak Attack Timer
registlet.detail: The skill `Sneak Attack` changes into a time-based buff instead of remaining use-based.
registlet.note: The buff duration is 1 second per skill level of `Sneak Attack`.

registlet.name: Aura Blade Force
registlet.detail: Releases a shock wave (single target attack) dealing 10% damage per level if the monster targeted by `Aura Blade` is out of range.

registlet.name: Distant Buster Lance
registlet.detail: Increases the power of `Buster Lance` by 10% per level. The range and distance at which the power starts to weaken is increased, making it always a long-range attack.

registlet.name: Invincible Dauntless
registlet.detail: `Dauntless` accumulates 1 second faster, but the count will decrease by 12 (-3 per level) when taking damage. However, it won't decrease if the damage is blocked with Guard or certain Mononofu skills.
registlet.note: The count will also not decrease when taking damage if you have 100 `Dauntless` stacks.

registlet.name: Evasion Set
registlet.detail: Evasion becomes usable even with equipment that doesn't allow it.
registlet.note:
This Registlet gives 2 manual evasions or 1 auto evasion (10-second cooldown).
This effect will not apply if you are equipped with an equipment that already enables Evasion.

registlet.name: Damage Check
registlet.detail: Displays an additional warning message when stepping on a warning area if the damage from the enemy attack exceeds 50% of your current HP.

registlet.name: Role Model
registlet.detail: Greatly suppresses your own damage output to increase your party's EXP Gain by 1% per level.
registlet.note: While equipped with this Registlet, your damage is capped to 1% of the enemy's HP.

registlet.name: Knight's Intuition
registlet.detail: Anticipate increases by 1% per level if a one-handed sword is equipped. Equipping a shield will triple the amount increased.

registlet.name: Berserk Rush
registlet.detail: Reduces the negative effect of `Berserk` by 1% per level if you take damage from a monster while the skill is active.

registlet.name: Ironhearted Chronos Drive
registlet.detail: Changes the additional attack effect of `Chronos Drive` from magic attack (based on INT) to physical attack (based on STR).
registlet.note: Scaling remains the same. Proration usage of additional hits changes to physical proration.

registlet.name: Water Release: Aqua Mirror
registlet.detail: Changes `Water Release` from a deployable skill to a buff skill.
registlet.note: Basically water zone & `Vortex` zone will be moving with the caster (like `Magic: Wall` with `Spell Calibration: follow`).

registlet.name: Violent Lunar Misfortune
registlet.detail:
While `Storm Reaper`'s buff is active the skill `Lunar Misfortune` becomes a close-range attack regardless of distance.

15 seconds (-1 second per level) cooldown after activation.

registlet.name: Purifying Twin Buster Blade
registlet.detail: The power of `Twin Buster Blade` now increases based on the number of debuffs (max 1 type per level) on the target.

registlet.name: Distinct Parabola Cannon
registlet.detail: The skill `Parabola Cannon` now only hits monster currently in combat and guarantees a critical hit.

registlet.name: Lunar Slash Absorber
registlet.detail: When gaining a new stack, each of current `Lunar Slash` stacks is converted into Registlet's level × `Lunar Slash`'s stacks MP.

registlet.name: Exclusive Bodyguard
registlet.detail: Reduces the Physical/Magic/Fractional Damage received by the mercenary or partner summoned as a Defender by 3% per level.

registlet.name: Red Zone Shield
registlet.detail:
Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a red warning by 1% per level.

However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10% (disadvantage).
registlet.note: This damage reduction applies multiplicatively with other damage reductions such as Refinement, Resistance.

registlet.name: Blue Zone Shield
registlet.detail:
Reduces the damage from monster attacks shown with a blue warning by 1% per level.

However, damage taken from single-target attacks increases by 10% (disadvantage).
registlet.note: This damage reduction applies multiplicatively with other damage reductions such as Refinement, Resistance.

registlet.name: Thunder Release Modifier
registlet.detail: Reduces the fixed damage of `Thunder Release` by 100 (-10 per level), but it will now inflict [Flinch].
registlet.note: It's constant penalty and at Lv10 = 0 penalty.

registlet.name: Magic Vanquisher
registlet.detail: Changes the skill `Vanquisher` from a physical attack to magic attack.
registlet.note: Let's wait someone test it for the magic mechanics.

registlet.name: Skull Shaker Suppressor
registlet.detail: Reduces the power of the skill `Skull Shaker`, but it will no longer inflict [Stun].
registlet.note: There is no difference in damage calculation of `Skull Shaker`. But the max stack of `Skull Shaker` is now maxed at Registlet's level.

registlet.name: Stonebreaker's Privilege
registlet.detail: Becomes invincible for 0.1 second per level after [Petrified] is removed.

registlet.name: Fast Eater
registlet.detail: Reduces item cooldown by 1 second per level(?) after [Item Disabled] is removed.
registlet.note: [Item Disabled] is ailment that enemy inflicted to player, like boss Rondine's shark.

registlet.name: Anti-Slip
registlet.detail: Shortens [Knock Back] distance by 1 meter per level(?).
